mechanism: Armodafinil may increase risperidone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and additive CNS stimulation with antipsychotic effects, while armodafinil's wakefulness-promoting properties may counteract risperidone's sedating effects.
action: Monitor for increased risperidone adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis) and antipsychotic efficacy; consider risperidone dose reduction if toxicity emerges; avoid combining if possible or use with caution and clinical supervision.
